en: Put your first charcoal on the grill.

en: Burn a cut. It happens to the best of us.

en: Deliver and get paid for your first order.

en: Deliver every cut on the route in a single run.

en: Get one of the big tips.

en: Finish a shift without a single strike.

en: Reach the seventh shift in a single run.

en: Move your stand to the second stop on the route.

es: Llegá a la última parada de la ruta.
en: Reach the last stop on the route.

en: Lose so many customers you have to close early.

en: One bad night away from losing the run to strikes: close a shift properly.

en: Serve the special customer who shows up on some days.
